glosses: The breast or chest of a human (or sometimes of another animal).

examples.text: Serene, smiling, enigmatic, she faced him with no fear whatever showing in her dark eyes.[…]She put back a truant curl from her forehead where it had sought egress to the world, and looked him full in the face now, drawing a deep breath which caused the round of her bosom to lift the lace at her throat.

glosses: The seat of one's inner thoughts, feelings, etc.; one's secret feelings; desire.

examples.text: my poor dear duke[…], in consequence of the excitement created in his august bosom by her frantic violence and grief, had a fit in which I very nigh lost him.

glosses: The protected interior or inner part of something; the area enclosed as by an embrace.

examples.text: … Mr Toodle … was refreshing himself with tea in the bosom of his family.
